title: Test version Overlay Reminder with Next Steps and Benefit Communication
description:
## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

As a user trying out a trial version, it is important that I can see how long I have left and what my next options are.

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:gorilla:</custom> Goal

Increase subscriptions by active communication to trial users.

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-2">:brain:</custom> Assumptions

* Trial users are more concerned with the next steps if you provide them with a simple overview by means of a banner or button
* By exerting gentle pressure, we as a brand are not aggressive, but friendly and helpful, because we provide decision-making aids and a feeling of transparency. This in turn has a positive effect on the purchase decision.
* if you then insert a countdown in the last 3 days of the trial version, this is not regarded as a "raid", but as a reminder
